applicable.description: False when the call is too thin to judge (no caller turns, or an immediate drop).

responseQuality.description: 0-100. Omit entirely when applicable is false — never send 0 as a placeholder.

responseQualityJustification.description: One line, specific to this call, naming the behaviour or criterion the score rests on.

sentiment.description: Dominant caller emotion across the call.

sentimentReason.description: Short reason, quoting or paraphrasing the caller.

overallAssessment.description: 2-3 sentences on whether the call met the SOW's intent.
